commands.doc: Insert text at a char offset of the scratch buffer.
commands.name: buffer.insert

offset.description:
Char index (Unicode scalar values, not bytes) before which to insert; equal to the
buffer length to append.

len_chars.description: Buffer length in chars after the insert.

commands.doc: Return the whole text of the scratch buffer.
commands.name: buffer.text

commands.doc: Return a document's selection (anchor and head, char offsets) and the head's line and column. Read-only.

examples.description: the selection follows an insert before it

commands.name: cursor.get

result_schema.description: Result of every `cursor.*` command: the selection of the document afterwards.

anchor.description: Char offset of the selection's anchor (the end that stays put while extending).

col.description: Zero-based column of the head, in chars.

head.description: Char offset of the selection's head (the caret).

result_schema.title: CursorResult

commands.doc: Move a document's selection head one step by char, word or line, computed from the head before the move. Without `extend` the selection collapses at the new head; with it only the head moves. Ends the document's typing group.

examples.description: extend a line down (no goal column)

commands.name: cursor.move

oneOf.description: One char; a CRLF is one step.
Over non-word chars, then word chars (`_` or alphanumeric).
The same column on the next or previous line, clamped to its length.

extend.description:
True to move only the head (extend the selection); false (default) to collapse the
selection at the moved head.

forward.description: True to move towards the end of the text (down for `line`).

result_schema.description: Result of every `cursor.*` command: the selection of the document afterwards.

anchor.description: Char offset of the selection's anchor (the end that stays put while extending).

col.description: Zero-based column of the head, in chars.

head.description: Char offset of the selection's head (the caret).

result_schema.title: CursorResult

commands.doc: Set a document's selection to `anchor`..`head` (char offsets; `head` defaults to `anchor`). Ends the document's typing group.
commands.name: cursor.set

anchor.description: Char offset of the anchor (`0..=len_chars`, not between `\r` and `\n`).

head.description:
Char offset of the head; defaults to `anchor` (a caret). Omit it for a caret; `null`
is refused.

result_schema.description: Result of every `cursor.*` command: the selection of the document afterwards.

anchor.description: Char offset of the selection's anchor (the end that stays put while extending).

col.description: Zero-based column of the head, in chars.

head.description: Char offset of the selection's head (the caret).

result_schema.title: CursorResult

commands.doc: Close a document. A dirty document is refused unless `discard` is true. The id is never reused.
commands.name: doc.close

discard.description: Close even if the document has unsaved changes (they are lost; the file is untouched).

closed.description: Whether the document is now closed (true).

doc.description: Id of the closed document (never reused).

commands.doc: Delete the chars `start..end` of a document and return them.
commands.name: doc.delete

end.description: Char index after the last one to remove (`start <= end <= len_chars`).

dirty.description: Whether the text now differs from the file's last opened or saved text.

len_chars.description: Length in chars after the edit.

commands.doc: Return a document's path, encoding, line endings, length, dirty flag and undo/redo availability.
commands.name: doc.info

EncodingName.description: Encoding detected when the document was opened (used for save).

oneOf.description: UTF-16 little-endian with a byte-order mark.
UTF-16 big-endian with a byte-order mark.

LineEndingName.description: Dominant line ending of a document's current text.

oneOf.description: The text has no line break.

dirty.description: Whether the text differs from the file's last opened or saved text.

encoding.description: Encoding detected at open (used for save).

line_ending.description: Dominant line ending of the current text.

mixed_line_endings.description: True iff the current text has line breaks of more than one kind.

commands.doc: Insert text at a char offset of a document. Successive one-char inserts form one undo step (kiln-text typing-group rule).
commands.name: doc.insert

offset.description: Char index before which to insert; equal to the length to append.

dirty.description: Whether the text now differs from the file's last opened or saved text.

len_chars.description: Length in chars after the edit.

commands.doc: Return the text (without its line break), start and end char offsets and line break of one line of a document. Lines split on `\r\n`, `\r` and `\n`; a text with k breaks has k + 1 lines. Read-only.

examples.description: a line ended by a lone CR, with an astral char
the empty last line after a final LF

commands.name: doc.line

LineBreakName.description: The line break that ends a line.

oneOf.description: No line break: the last line of the text.

end.description: Char offset after the line's content (`start` + chars in `text`).

ending.description: The line break after `text` (`none` for the last line).

start.description: Char offset of the line's first char.

text.description: The line's content without its line break.

commands.doc: List the open documents, sorted by id.
commands.name: doc.list

docs.description: The open documents, sorted by id.

commands.doc: Open a file as a document and return its id. Opening a path that is already open returns the existing document unchanged, with `already_open: true`.

examples.description: re-opening an open, edited path returns the existing document

commands.name: doc.open

path.description: Root-relative path of the file (`/`-separated; no `.`, `..` or empty segments).

EncodingName.description: Encoding detected when the document was opened (used for save).

oneOf.description: UTF-16 little-endian with a byte-order mark.
UTF-16 big-endian with a byte-order mark.

LineEndingName.description: Dominant line ending of a document's current text.

oneOf.description: The text has no line break.

already_open.description: True iff the path was already open (the existing document is returned, unchanged).

len_chars.description: Length of the current text in chars.

line_ending.description: Dominant line ending of the current text.

mixed_line_endings.description: True iff the current text has line breaks of more than one kind.

commands.doc: Convert a position of a document given as exactly one of a char offset, a byte offset, a UTF-16 offset or a line/column (column in chars) into all of these forms. Read-only.

examples.description: a char offset after a two-byte char
a UTF-16 offset after a surrogate pair

commands.name: doc.position

At.description: A position in exactly one unit.

oneOf.description: A UTF-8 byte offset on a char boundary.
A UTF-16 code-unit offset, not inside a surrogate pair.
A line and a column within the line's content.

LineColParams.description: A line and a column (in chars) of `doc.position`.

col.description: Zero-based column, in chars from the start of the line.

at.description: The position, given in exactly one unit.

result_schema.description: Result of `doc.position`: every form of the same position.
result_schema.title: PositionResult

commands.doc: Redo the most recently undone step of a document. A successful redo ends the typing group. With nothing to redo (`redone: false`) nothing changes: not the text, the dirty flag, the selection, the undo history or an open typing group, so a one-char insert after it still joins the typing before it.
commands.name: doc.redo

dirty.description: Whether the text now differs from the file's last opened or saved text.

redone.description: True iff a step was redone (false: nothing to redo, nothing changed).

commands.doc: Replace the chars `start..end` of a document with text, as one undo step, and return the removed text.
commands.name: doc.replace

end.description: Char index after the last one to replace (`start <= end <= len_chars`).

dirty.description: Whether the text now differs from the file's last opened or saved text.

len_chars.description: Length in chars after the edit.

commands.doc: Write the document to its file in its encoding, keeping line endings verbatim (atomic replace). Ends the current typing group.
commands.name: doc.save

bytes_written.description: Number of bytes written to the file.

dirty.description: Whether the document is dirty after the save (false).

commands.doc: Return the whole current text of a document.
commands.name: doc.text

commands.doc: Undo the most recent undo step of a document. A successful undo ends the typing group. With nothing to undo (`undone: false`) nothing changes: not the text, the dirty flag, the selection or the redo history; no typing group is open then, because an open typing group is itself the most recent undo step.
commands.name: doc.undo

dirty.description: Whether the text now differs from the file's last opened or saved text.

undone.description: True iff a step was undone (false: nothing to undo, nothing changed).

commands.doc: Count a document's line breaks per kind (`\r\n` first, then lone `\r` and `\n`). Read-only.

examples.description: a file with mixed line endings

commands.name: eol.counts

LineEndingName.description: Dominant line ending of a document's current text.

oneOf.description: The text has no line break.

crlf.description: Number of `\r\n` line breaks (matched before lone `\r` and `\n`).

line_ending.description: Dominant line ending of the current text (as in `doc.info`).

mixed_line_endings.description: True iff the current text has line breaks of more than one kind (as in `doc.info`).

commands.doc: Rewrite every line break of a document that differs from `to` (default: the dominant line ending) as `to`, as one undo step. The selection maps through each rewritten break. If no break differs, nothing changes.

examples.description: normalise a mixed file to LF
default target: the dominant line ending

commands.name: eol.normalize

to.description:
The line ending every break is rewritten to; defaults to the document's dominant one
(`doc.info.line_ending`). Omit it for the default; `null` is refused.

LineEndingName.description: Dominant line ending of a document's current text.

oneOf.description: The text has no line break.

changed.description: Number of line breaks rewritten (those that differed from the target).

mixed_line_endings.description: True iff the text still has line breaks of more than one kind (as in `doc.info`).

commands.doc: List the project (or the directory `path`) as a tree, in preorder with each directory's entries in byte order of their names. Honours the project's `.gitignore` files, skips the directory whose path is exactly `target` and every `.git`, lists symlinks and special files without following or opening them, and lists a directory whose path has 128 or more segments without descending into it. Rules: docs/protocol/project.md.

examples.description: list a project with a .gitignore and a target directory
list one directory, at most one entry

commands.name: project.tree

limit.description: The most entries to list (1 to 1,000,000; default 50,000). Ignored entries do not count.

path.description:
Root-relative path of the directory to list (`/`-separated; no `.`, `..` or empty
segments). Omit it for the root; `null` is refused.

KindName.description: Kind of a listed entry (its own kind: a symlink is never followed).

oneOf.description: A symbolic link, whatever it points to; never followed.
A FIFO, socket or device; never opened.

path.description: Root-relative path; it begins with the requested `path` as given.

entries.description: Entries in preorder; each directory's entries in byte order of their names.

ignored.description:
Entries not listed (and not descended) because they are the directory whose path is
exactly `target`, are named `.git`, or are ignored by a `.gitignore`.

skipped.description: Names not listed because they are not UTF-8 or not a valid path segment.

too_deep.description: Directories listed and not descended into because their path has 128 or more segments.

truncated.description: True iff an entry beyond `limit` exists.

internal.when: a command panicked (a bug in Kiln)
a command's result violates its own schema (a bug in Kiln)

rejected.when: the path is not a valid root-relative path (see Paths in `docs/control-protocol.md`)
no open document has this id
`doc.close` of a modified document without `discard`
the file (or, for a save, its directory) does not exist
the path names a directory or another non-regular file where a file is needed, or a file where a directory is needed
any other file-system failure (permissions, name too long, …)
the file is not valid UTF-8 / UTF-16 text
an offset beyond the end of the text
a range whose start is after its end
any other refusal
the search pattern is empty or is not a valid regular expression
a file of a replace preview changed or was removed since the preview
no stored replace preview has this id
external tools are off for this session (the default)
the external tool's program was not found
the external tool ran longer than its limit and was stopped
the external tool failed or gave no usable result
the replayed tool recording has no output for this request
rustfmt could not format the text
the file changed or was removed on disk since it was read
the keymap file or chord is not valid
a position inside a character, a surrogate pair or a CRLF line break
the path resolves outside the root
